newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's APM drug firm H1 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's APM drug firm H1 profits up.

text.p: Jordan's Arab Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Company, one of the country's leading drug manufacturers, saw pre-tax profits for the first half of 1996 rise to 2.5 million dinars, up 38 percent against the same period last year.
A copy of the company's half year budget showed a slight fall in total sales to 11.4 million dinars from 12.5 million compared to the same period last year.
A company official said the improved performance was due to both reduced expenses and improved retail prices for over 100 drug brands the company manufactures.
The firm's main export markets are Iraq, Gulf Arab states Algeria and Tunisia, as well as some Eastern European markets such as Bulgaria and Romania.
